about_short_description.short_description: FileOrbis provides an Enterprise Content Management platform for businesses to manage, share, and protect their files securely.

product.name: Smart SFTP Platform
product.description: A platform that provides secure, unified SFTP access to files across disparate storage systems without requiring data migration.

product.name: Secure Session Management
product.description: A suite of tools to enforce secure user sessions with features like single session enforcement, customizable session rules, anti-forgery token validation, CAPTCHA, and multi-factor authentication.

product.name: AI Data Delivery Hub
product.description: A customizable platform for deploying Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) AI with local or cloud LLMs, secure vector storage, and intelligent data orchestration.

product.name: AI Enabler
product.description: A solution that connects local file systems to AI and chatbot platforms, enabling real-time, secure, conversational AI access without workflow changes.

product.name: AI Governance
product.description: A platform that controls and filters data accessible to AI systems, enforcing compliance through sensitive data filtering, anonymization, and permission checks.

product.name: File Server Integration
product.description: Integration with existing file servers to enhance file management, security, and accessibility without altering current infrastructure or permissions.
